compiler.stops_at: observation candidates. Canonical events belong to the event authority (phase0, still converging); this lane mints none.

consent_record.reverification_path: Page access token refresh via lane-L broker; invalid_grant or consent withdrawal suspends the connector pending re-consent.
consent_record.stored_at: secure-vault:facebook/oauth (lane-L custody; capability handle cap_ issued to agents)

scopes.purpose: List Pages the user manages so the connect UI can offer the right Page.
Read Page metadata, posts, engagement counts (identity leg).
Read posts/visitor content on the Page, including comments (prospect-reply surface).

token_lifecycle.reconsent_trigger: owner completes the Facebook Login flow again

cost.quota_cost: Business Use Case rate limit bucket (per Page/app)

lossy_fields: message (truncated by provider on very long posts)

sanitization.html_policy: ingestion-boundary plain-text-out (kit sanitize.ts; production DOMPurify at same boundary)
sanitization.unicode_policy: NFC normalize; mixed-script business names flagged for review
sanitization.url_policy: no outbound fetches in v1 (read API only)

failure_modes.connector_action: circuit breaker 60s, bounded retry x3, then OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; reconcile by re-read
honor Retry-After, then report FAILED; next dispatch may proceed
reject with recorded attempt; skip poison records individually
failure_modes.detection_signal: body does not parse as Graph edge response

failure_modes.connector_action: stop; surface as user_error; broker refresh single-flight; SUSPENDED on revoked class
SUCCEEDED with partial:true + skipped list; never silently complete
failure_modes.detection_signal: some records skipped (oversized, missing id, unparseable)
provider terms update notice / permission deprecation

failure_modes.connector_action: record skipped with reason; evidence of the skip recorded

facebook.conversations.note: Messenger conversation ingestion. Needs the pages_messaging scope (NOT requested in v1). Read path is pre-structured: add a stream descriptor + CONVERSATIONS_EDGE (src/graph-api.ts) with zero new machinery.

webhook-receive.note: Meta Page webhooks (X-Hub-Signature-256, verify-before-parse) declared as a future capability, not v1. Polling is the v1 transport.

response.message: facebook page reachable; declared read surface verified

request.governor_dispatch_id: required in production; fixture runs omit

connection_ref.description: Lane-L vault pointer to the OAuth connection. Vault ref, never a raw secret.

page_id.description: Connected Page id (source_account). Vault/config value, never hardcoded.

principal.description: Named party that granted access (Nolan's bootstrap identity), resolved from config/env.

version.description: Graph API version override; default v26.0.

identity_policy.link_method: auth-derived (page admin grant); linking to a PING business object is a separate graded step
identity_policy.merge_rule: A Facebook page id never merges PING business objects without OWNER_ASSERTED confirmation.
A Facebook post id never merges PING business objects without OWNER_ASSERTED confirmation.
A Facebook comment id never merges PING business objects without OWNER_ASSERTED confirmation.

validation_rules.reject_message: Manifest missing mandatory top-level sections: connector is DISABLED.
v1 is read-only; any write capability keeps the connector DISABLED pending elevated grant.

validation_rules.check: no raw credential values in config_schema or examples
validation_rules.reject_message: Raw secrets in the manifest keep the connector DISABLED.
